# Prototype-only alphaTab assets

Source: npm package @coderline/alphatab@1.8.4, downloaded with npm pack.
Includes dist/alphaTab.min.js, Bravura WOFF/WOFF2 fonts, package LICENSE and Bravura-OFL.txt.
No soundfont, audio playback or root dependency change.

Upstream: https://github.com/CoderLine/alphaTab
API: https://alphatab.net/docs/reference/api/tex
View profiles: https://alphatab.net/docs/reference/types/staveprofile/
